reactions.description: opaC is a FAD-containing monooxygenase and could be a good candidate for a consecutive hydroxylation at C12 of the oxepin ring
The regio-and stereo specific hydroxylation of Protuboxepin A by opaC is accompanied by a doublebond migration, leading to the conversion of a 1H-oxepin to a 3H-oxepin system in 15-epi-oxepinamide E
